_comment: Kingman coalescent trees, built in process -- no IQ-TREE, no FASTA. One file describes the whole job; edit this, not the scripts.
_params: the pool on disk was built with pop_size 1.0, mu 0.1, L 10000 -- change one of these and it is a different pool, built from scratch
_sizes: m=1000..4000 are already pooled at 10/cell; m=6000 is short 14 samples and m=8000 is short 36, and building those is where the time goes before any sweep starts
_per_bucket: one number per bucket and all equal: the eta pool is built per cell
_grid: the grid the 40 swept m=1000 trees are already on, so their L curves are reused and only the Lsym arm is computed
_operators: both Laplacian arms; the gate still weighs eta_S, which is what the eta buckets mean
